@graph.name: Meet Ian Vincent Rebuta in 80 seconds
@graph.description: Ian Vincent Rebuta explains how he builds systems that replace repetitive work: QA background, the AI call-audit fix at Nooro, a 24/7 AI concierge, and the automations he builds with Zapier, Apps Script and AI.
@graph.transcript: If your team does the same task every single day, I built the system that works for you. I'm Ian Vincent Rebuta from Bohol, Philippines, working on your hours, US, UK and Australia. I spent six years in quality assurance for US companies, including leading 23 QAs across three countries. And that is where I learned how to spot the work that repeats and where it breaks. At Nooro, I rebuilt the AI knowledge base behind our AI call audits. So the AI stopped giving wrong answers. And the customer experience team held 97% satisfaction score. I built an AI concierge from GoHighLevel so it works even if you sleep, which makes the churn rate narrow down to nearly 0%. Follow-ups, reports, data entry and even social media postings, those are the automated tasks that I can actually do for your business. I map how your team does it today and build it with Zapier, Google Apps Script and the AI tools that I currently use. So it runs without anyone babysitting on it. Tell me the task that you currently do every single day and I'll make sure that that will be the last day that you'll be doing it by your hand.

mainEntity.name: What services does Ian Vincent Rebuta offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Four kinds of work: operations and QA (call audits, SOPs, reports, CRM follow-up), social media management (content calendars, captions, scheduling and posting), video and animation (reels, brand films and animated shorts), and web and AI automation (landing pages, web apps, AI concierges, Zapier and Google Apps Script).

mainEntity.name: Does Ian Vincent Rebuta work US hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. He works remotely from Bohol, Philippines (GMT+8) on US Eastern business hours, and has worked with US teams since 2020.

mainEntity.name: What kind of role is Ian Vincent Rebuta looking for?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full-time remote role or ongoing project work with a US team, in operations, social media, video or web. He is available now.

mainEntity.name: Can he manage social media for several brands at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. He currently plans, writes, schedules and posts for ten Facebook and Instagram accounts across real estate, hobby retail, weddings, cabin rentals and more, from one GoKaizn planner, and makes the reels they post.

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Monday.com, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, Real Geeks, Zendesk, GoKaizn, Meta Business Suite, Canva, CapCut, Photoshop, HTML, CSS and JavaScript, GitHub, Vercel, Claude Code, Google AI Studio, Zapier and Google Apps Script.
